name: Md Nafiu Rahman
title: Lecturer | BRAC University
bio: Hi! I am a Lecturer at BRAC University. In Summer 2026, I was a Summer Research Intern at UIUC through the UIUC++ SRSE program. I graduated with honors in CSE from BUET in 2025, where my thesis sparked my passion for Software Engineering research. My work focuses on AI4SE, specifically using Large Language Models for software security problems such as secret detection, and on software testing, where I study whether tests actually check the behavior they cover. My long-term goal is to build intelligent tools that improve developer productivity and software reliability.
